bid.description: REQUIRED. A string identifying the iMessage extension that the user interacts with while using the Messages app.

data.description: A dictionary containing additional information for Apple Messages for Business interactive messages

receivedMessage.description: A dictionary with information telling the Messages app what content and how to display it in the received message bubble.

replyMessage.description: A dictionary with information telling the Messages app what and how to display it in the reply message bubble.
